themes.description: Users repeatedly report slow performance, frequent app crashes, OTP delays, outdated UI, and a lack of timely customer support, causing frustration and loss of trading opportunities.
themes.business_impact: The negative experience drives users to abandon the platform, leading to significant churn, reduced trading volume, increased support tickets, and a damaged brand reputation that hinders user acquisition.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app suffers from outdated architecture, suboptimal code paths, insufficient backend scalability, and a lack of comprehensive performance testing, resulting in high latency, UI freezes, and unstable network handling.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a full performance audit and identify bottlenecks
• Refactor core trading engine and upgrade libraries
• Implement robust OTP delivery with retries and monitoring
• Revamp UI with a modern design system and simplify navigation
• Enhance backend scalability with load balancing, caching, and async processing
• Deploy automated regression and load testing pipelines
• Establish dedicated customer support SLA with rapid response times
• Release incremental updates with thorough testing and monitoring

themes.description: Customers report that brokerage, annual maintenance, and other charges are higher than advertised or not clearly disclosed, leading to surprise bills and perceived over‑charging.
themes.business_impact: Customers are leaving the platform for competitors such as Angel One and Groww, inflating churn and acquisition costs, and eroding trust which directly impacts ARPU and long‑term revenue.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The fee structure is opaque and inconsistently applied across product lines; AMC is auto‑charged without clear pre‑approval, and the billing system mis‑calculates or mis‑labels charges, creating a perception of hidden or inflated costs.
themes.action_plan:
• Revise fee disclosure in the onboarding flow and help centre
• Implement a pre‑trade cost calculator in the UI
• Change AMC to be deducted from account balance rather than as a separate yearly charge
• Conduct a billing audit to identify and correct miscalculated charges
• Train customer support on fee policies and dispute resolution
• Roll out a communication campaign to rebuild trust
